assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art RPG character animation sprite atlas. Input image 1 is the warrior character identity and palette reference. Create a NEW sprite sheet with the SAME red-haired warrior, silver armor, blue tabard, red cape, sword and round shield, facing RIGHT. Real transparent alpha background, no backdrop or floor shadow. Canvas exactly 2048 x 1024 (2:1), split into precisely FOUR equal square columns and TWO equal square rows, EIGHT individual complete character frames total; NO drawn gridlines. Each 512x512 cell has character center at x=256, fixed feet baseline at y=450 relative to cell, and the same body scale/head size in all eight cells. Keep all pixels including sword/cape within the cell with at least 8% edge padding. Row TOP left-to-right is a 4-frame looping breathing idle: ready stance, shoulders rise slightly/cape flexes, breathe out/cape trails, return toward ready. Row BOTTOM left-to-right is a 4-frame rightward sword slash: crouched windup with sword raised, forceful horizontal slash toward right, low follow-through with cape flaring, recovery toward ready. Clear DIFFERENT ARM AND SWORD POSES for action frames, actual anatomical movement. Feet stay planted near same baseline. Crisp detailed 16-bit pixel art with hard square pixel clusters matching reference, no antialias blur, no text, no labels, no borders, no extra characters, no external attack effects. Each cell must contain exactly ONE full-body warrior with no clipping or cell overlap. Production uniform atlas suitable for CSS steps(4) playback, all cells equally spaced.
